ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels with localized high-intensity (white/light-grey) clusters concentrated on the left lobe and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast light-intensity geometric blobs (mottling/scars) are mapped to the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible across the entire trailing edge boundary, particularly pronounced on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two primary circular high-contrast pixel clusters located on the mid-outer portion of the left lobe and one cluster at the terminal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular high-intensity marks on the left lobe and right tip, likely resulting from barnacle attachment or surface trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible white pigmentation on the extreme lateral tips of the trailing edge.
